propers.incipit: Deus, dum egrederis coram populo tuo
propers.name: Introit

masses.name: Thursday within the Octave of Pentecost

propers.incipit: Factus est repente de caelo sonus
propers.name: Communion

propers.incipit: O quam bonus et suavis est, Domine, Spiritus tuus in nobis
propers.name: Alleluia

propers.incipit: Caritas Dei diffusa est in cordibus nostris
propers.name: Introit

propers.incipit: Benedictus es, Domine Deus patrum nostrorum
propers.name: Fifth Alleluia

propers.incipit: Caritas Dei diffusa est in cordibus nostris
propers.name: Introit
Collect
propers.text:
Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui dedisti famulis tuis in confessione
verae fidei, aeternae Trinitatis gloriam agnoscere, et in potentia
majestatis adorare Unitatem: quaesumus; ut, ejusdem fidei firmitate, ab
omnibus semper muniamur adversis. Per Dominum.

translations.text: O almighty and ever lasting God who has ted thy servants, in the confession of the true faith to acknowledge the glory of an Eternal Trinity, and in the power of majesty, to adore an Unity: we beseech thee that, by the strength of this faith, we may be defended from all adversity. Thro'.

propers.incipit: Benedictus es, Domine, qui intueris abyssos
propers.name: Gradual

propers.incipit: Benedictus es, Domine, Deus patrum nostrorum
propers.name: Alleluia
Secret
propers.text:
Sanctifica, quaesumus, Domine, Deus noster, per tui sancti nominis
invocationem, hujus oblationis hostiam: et per eam nosmetipsos tibi
perfice munus aeternum. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Sanctify, we beseech thee, O Lord, our God, by the invocation of thy holy name, the victim of this oblation: and by it make us an eternal offering to thee. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Proficiat nobis ad salutem corporis et animae, Domine, Deus noster,
hujus sacramenti susceptio: et sempiternae sanctae Trinitatis
ejusdemque individuae Unitatis confessio. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May the receiving of this sacrament, O Lord our God, avail us to the salvation of body and soul: together with the confession of an everlasting Holy Trinity, and of the undivided unity thereof. Thro'.

masses.name: Mass of the First Sunday after Pentecost

propers.incipit: Sacerdotes Domini incensum et panes offerunt Deo
propers.name: Offertory
Collect
propers.text:
Sancti nominis tui, Domine, timorem pariter et amorem fac nos habere
perpetuum: quia numquam tua gubernatione destituis, quos in soliditate
tuae dilectionis instituis. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Grant us, O Lord, both a constant love and fear of thy holy name: since thou never withdrawest thy protection from those, whom thou solidly groundest in thy love. Thro'.

propers.incipit: Domine, Deus meus, in te speravi
propers.name: Alleluia
Secret
propers.text:
Oblatio nos, Domine, tuo nomini dicanda purificet: et de die in diem ad
coelestis vitae transferat actionem. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May this sacrifice offered to thy name purify us, O Lord: and make us every day advance towards a heavenly life. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Sumptis muneribus sacris, quaesumus, Domine: ut cum frequentatione
mysterii, crescat nostrae salutis effectus. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Having received, O Lord, this sacred oblation, grant, that by frequenting these mysteries we may hasten our salvation.

masses.name: The Most Sacred Heart of Jesus

propers.incipit: Unus militum lancea latus ejus aperuit
propers.name: Communion

propers.incipit: Respice in me et miserere mei
propers.name: Introit
Collect
propers.text:
Protector in te sperantium, Deus, sine quo nihil est validum, nihil
sanctum: multiplica super nos misericordiam tuam; ut, te rectore, te
duce, sic transeamus per bona temporalia, ut non amittamus aeterna. Per
Dominum.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Respice, Domine, munera supplicantis Ecclesiae: et saluti credentium
perpetua sanctificatione sumenda concede. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Look down, O Lord, on the offerings of thy suppliant Church; and grant that thy faithful may always worthily partake thereof in order to their salvation. Thro'.

propers.incipit: Dico vobis: gaudium est Angelis Dei
propers.name: Communion
Postcommunion
propers.text:
Sancta tua nos, Domine, sumpta vivificent: et misericordiae sempiternae
praeparent expiatos. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May thy sacred mysteries, O Lord, which we have received, give us life: and cleansing us from our sins, make us worthy of thy eternal mercy. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Da nobis, quaesumus, Domine: ut et mundi cursus pacifice nobis tuo
ordine dirigatur; et Ecclesia tua tranquilla devotione laetetur. Per
Dominum.

translations.text: Grant, we beseech thee, O Lord, that the world, with regard to us, may be governed in peace by thy providence, and thy Church pay her devotions to thee in tranquillity. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Oblationibus nostris, quaesumus, Domine, placare susceptis: et ad te
nostras etiam rebelles compelle propitius voluntates. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Receive our offerings, we beseech thee, O Lord, and be appeased thereby: and mercifully compel our wills to yield to thee, even when they rebel. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Mysteria nos, Domine, quaesumus, sumpta purificent: et suo munere
tueantur. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May the mysteries we have received, both purify and defend us, O Lord, by the efficacy of what they contain. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui diligentibus te bona invisibilia praeparasti: infunde
cordibus nostris tui amoris affectum; ut te in omnibus et super omnia
diligentes, promissiones tuas, quae omne desiderium superant,
consequamur. Per Dominum.

translations.text: O God, who hast prepared invisible good things for those that love thee: pour forth into our hearts an affectionate love for thee: that loving thee in all things, and above all things, we may come to the enjoyment of thy promises which are above whatever we can desire Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Propitiare, Domine, supplicationibus nostris: et has oblationes
famulorum famularumque tuarum benignus assume; ut, quod singuli
obtulerunt ad honorem nominis tui, cunctis proficiat ad salutem. Per
Dominum.

translations.text: Be appeased, O Lord, by our humble prayers, and mercifully receive these offerings of thy servants: that what each hath offered to the honour of thy name, may avail to the salvation of all.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Quos coelesti, Domine, dono satiasti: praesta, quaesumus; ut a nostris
mundemur occultis et ab hostium liberemur insidiis. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Grant, O Lord, we beseech thee: that we, whom thou hast fed with this heavenly sacrifice, may be cleansed from our hidden sins and delivered from the snares of our enemies Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus virtutum, cujus est totum quod est optimum: insere pectoribus
nostris amorem tui nominis, et praesta in nobis religionis augmentum;
ut, quae sunt bona, nutrias, ac pietatis studio, quae sunt nutrita,
custodias. Per Dominum.

translations.text: O God of all power, to whom entirely belongeth whatever is best: implant in our hearts the love of thy name, and grant us an increase of religion that thou mayest improve in us what is good, and preserve what thou thus improvest by the practice of piety. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Propitiare, Domine, supplicationibus nostris, et has populi tui
oblationes benignus assume: et, ut nullius sit irritum votum, nullius
vacua postulatio, praesta; ut, quod fideliter petimus, efficaciter
consequamur. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Repleti sumus, Domine, muneribus tuis: tribue, quaesumus; ut eorum et
mundemur effectu et muniamur auxilio. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, cujus providentia in sui dispositione non fallitur: te supplices
exoramus; ut noxia cuncta submoveas, et omnia nobis profutura
concedas. Per Dominum.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Deus, qui legalium differentiam hostiarum unius sacrificii perfectione
sanxisti: accipe sacrificium a devotis tibi famulis, et pari
benedictione, sicut munera Abel, sanctifica; ut, quod singuli
obtulerunt ad majestatis tuae honorem, cunctis proficiat ad salutem.
Per Dominum.

translations.text: O God, who in one perfect sacrifice hast united all the various sacrifices of the law, accept from thy devout servants this sacrifice, and sanctify it by the like blessing as thou didst the offering of Abel: that what each hath offered to thy divine Majesty, may avail to the salvation of all. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Tua nos, Domine, medicinalis operatio, et a nostris perversitatibus
clementer expediat, et ad ea, quae sunt recta, perducat. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Grant, O Lord, that the healing efficacy of these thy mysteries may, through thy mercy, free us from all our sins, and bring us to the practice of what is right. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Largire nobis, quaesumus, Domine, semper spiritum cogitandi quae recta
sunt, propitius et agendi: ut, qui sine te esse non possumus, secundum
te vivere valeamus. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Grant us, O Lord, we beseech thee, the spirit of thinking and doing wliat is right, that we, who cannot even subsist without thee, may live according to thee. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Suscipe, quaesumus, Domine, munera, quae tibi de tua largitate
deferimus: ut haec sacrosancta mysteria, gratiae tuae operante
virtute, et praesentis vitae nos conversatione sanctificent, et ad
gaudia sempiterna perducant. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Receive, we beseech thee, O Lord, the offerings we bring, which are the gifts of thine own bounty: that these most holy mysteries may, by the power of thy grace, make our conduct in this life holy, and bring us to those joys that will never end. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Sit nobis, Domine, reparatio mentis et corporis caeleste mysterium:
ut, cujus exsequimur cultum, sentiamus effectum. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May this heavenly mystery, O Lord, renew us both in soul and body: that we may find in ourselves the effects of what we celebrate. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Pateant aures misericordiae tuae, Domine, precibus supplicantium: et,
ut petentibus desiderata concedas; fac eos quae tibi sunt placita,
postulare. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May the ears of thy mercy, O Lord, be open to the prayers of thy suppliants: and, that they may succeed in their desires, make them ask those things that are agreeable to thee. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Concede nobis, quaesumus, Domine, haec digne frequentare mysteria:
quia, quoties hujus hostiae commemoratio celebratur, opus nostrae
redemptionis exercetur. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Grant us, O Lord, we beseech thee, frequently and worthily to celebrate these mysteries: for as many times as this commemorative sacrifice is celebrated, so often is the work of our redemption performed. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Tui nobis, quaesumus, Domine, communio sacramenti, et purificationem
conferat, et tribuat unitatem. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May the participation of this thy sacrament, O Lord, we beseech thee, both purify us, and unite us. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui omnipotentiam tuam parcendo maxime et miserando manifestas:
multiplica super nos misericordiam tuam; ut, ad tua promissa
currentes, caelestium bonorum facias esse consortes. Per Dominum.

translations.text: O God, who chiefly manifestest thy Almighty power in pardoning and shewing mercy, increase thy goodness towards us: that having recourse to thy promises, we may be partakers of thy heavenly blessing. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Tibi, Domine, sacrificia dicata reddantur: quae sic ad honorem
nominis tui deferenda tribuisti, ut eadem remedia fieri nostra
praestares. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May the sacrifice, we offer, O Lord, be presented before thee: which thou hast appointed to be offered in honour of thy name; and at the same time become a remedy to us. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Quaesumus, Domine, Deus noster: ut, quos divinis reparare non desinis
sacramentis, tuis non destituas benignus auxiliis. Per Dominum.

translations.text: We beseech thee, G Lord our God, that in thy mercy thou wouldst never deprive those of thy help, whom thou continually strengthenest by these divine mysteries. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui, abundantia pietatis tuae, et merita
supplicum excedis et vota: effunde super nos misericordiam tuam; ut
dimittas quae conscientia metuit, et adjicias quod oratio non
praesumit. Per Dominum.

translations.text: O Almighty and eternal God, who, in the abundance of thy goodness, exceedest both the merits and requests of thy suppliants; pour forth thy mercy upon us: and both pardon what our consciences dreadeth, and grant such blessings as we dare not presume to ask. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Respice, Domine, quaesumus, nostram propitius servitutem: ut, quod
offerimus, sit tibi munus acceptum, et sit nostrae fragilitatis
subsidium. Per Dominum.

translations.text: Look down, O Lord, we beseech thee, on our homage: that the offerings we make may be acceptable to thee, and a help to our weakness Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Sentiamus, quaesumus, Domine, tui perceptione sacramenti, subsidium
mentis et corporis: ut, in utroque salvati, caelestis remedii
plenitudine gloriemur. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May we receive, by the participation of these thy mysteries, we beseech thee, O Lord, help in body and mind: that in the salvation of both we may enjoy the full effect of this heavenly remedy. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Omnipotens et misericors Deus, de cujus munere venit, ut tibi a
fidelibus tuis digne et laudabiliter serviatur: tribue, quaesumus,
nobis; ut ad promissiones tuas sine offensione curramus. Per Dominum.

translations.text: O Almighty and merciful God, from whose gift it proceedeth that thy people worthily serve thee; grant we beseech thee, that we may run on, without stumbling, to the obtaining the effects of thy promises. Thro'.

propers.name: Offertory
propers.text:
Precatus est Moyses in conspectu Domini, Dei sui, et dixit: Quare,
Domine, irasceris in populo tuo? Parce irae animae tuae: memento
Abraham, Isaac et Jacob, quibus jurasti dare terram fluentem lac et
mel. Et placatus factus est Dominus de malignitate, quam dixit facere
populo suo.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Hostias, quaesumus, Domine, propitius intende, quas sacris altaribus
exhibemus: ut, nobis indulgentiam largiendo, tuo nomini dent honorem.
Per Dominum.

translations.text: Mercifully look down, O Lord, on the offerings we lay on thy holy altar; that they may be to the honour of thy name, by obtaining pardon for us. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Vivificet nos, quaesumus, Domine, hujus participatio sancta mysterii:
et pariter nobis expiationem tribuat et munimen. Per Dominum.

translations.text: May the sacred participation of these thy mysteries, O Lord, we beseech thee, give us life; and be to us both an expiation and protection. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, da nobis fidei, spei et caritatis
augmentum: et, ut mereamur assequi quod promittis, fac nos amare quod
praecipis. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: O Almighty and eternal God, grant us an increase of faith, hope, and charity; and, that we may deserve what thou promisest, make us love what thou commandest. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Propitiare, Domine, populo tuo, propitiare muneribus: ut, hac
oblatione placatus, et indulgentiam nobis tribuas et postulata
concedas. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Be thou propitious, O Lord, to thy people: and mercifully receive their offerings: that being appeased thereby, thou mayest grant us pardon, and hear our requests. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Sumptis, Domine, caelestibus sacramentis: ad redemptionis aeternae,
quaesumus, proficiamus augmentum. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum...

translations.text: May these heavenly mysteries, O Lord, which we have received, advance our eternal redemption. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Custodi, Domine, quaesumus, Ecclesiam tuam propitiatione perpetua:
et quia sine te labitur humana mortalitas; tuis semper auxiliis et
abstrahatur a noxiis et ad salutaria dirigatur. Per Dominum nostrum
Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Preserve, O Lord, we beseech thee, thy Church by thy constant mercy: and since our weak mortality is continually falling without thy assistance, may thy grace withdraw it from what is hurtful, and direct it in the ways of salvation. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Concede nobis, Domine, quaesumus, ut haec hostia salutaris et
nostrorum fiat purgatio delictorum, et tuae propitiatio potestatis.
Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Grant, we beseech thee, O Lord, that this victim of salvation may both cleanse us from our sins, and render thy Majesty propitious to us Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Purificent semper et muniant tua sacramenta nos, Deus: et ad
perpetuae ducant salvationis effectum. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum...

translations.text: May these thy mysteries, O God, continually purify us and strengthen us: and procure us eternal salvation. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Ecclesiam tuam, Domine, miseratio continuata mundet et muniat: et
quia sine te non potest salva consistere; tuo semper munere
gubernetur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: May thy continual mercy purify and defend thy church: and since without thee it cannot be safe, may it always be directed by the influence of thy grace. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Tua nos, Domine, sacramenta custodiant: et contra diabolicos semper
tueantur incursus. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: May thy mysteries, O Lord, preserve us, and always defend us against the attacks of the evil.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Mentes nostras et corpora possideat, quaesumus, Domine, doni
caelestis operatio: ut non noster sensus in nobis, sed jugiter ejus
praeveniat effectus. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: May the efficacy of these divine mysteries O Lord, possess both our souls and bodies: that their effects, not our own sensuality, may always take the lead in us. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Tua nos, quaesumus, Domine, gratia semper et praeveniat et sequatur:
ac bonis operibus jugiter praestet esse intentos. Per Dominum
nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: May thy grace, O Lord, always prevent and follow us; and make us constantly zealous in the practice of good works. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Munda nos, quaesumus, Domine, sacrificii praesentis effectu: et
perfice miseratus in nobis; ut ejus mereamur esse participes. Per
Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Cleanse us, O Lord, we beseech thee, by the efficacy of this sacrifice: and by thy mercy make us worthy to partake thereof. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Purifica, quaesumus, Domine, mentes nostras benignus, et renova
caelestibus sacramentis: ut consequenter et corporum praesens
pariter et futurum capiamus auxilium. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum...

translations.text: Mercifully, O Lord, we beseech thee, purify our souls, and renew them by these holy mysteries; that we may receive help thereby, both while we are in these mortal bodies and hereafter. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Da, quaesumus, Domine, populo tuo diabolica vitare contagia: et te
solum Deum pura mente sectari. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Grant, we beseech thee, O Lord, that thy people may avoid all contagion of the devil: and with a clean heart follow thee, the only true God. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Majestatem tuam, Domine, suppliciter deprecamur: ut haec sancta, quae
gerimus, et a praeteritis nos delictis exuant et futuris. Per Dominum
nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: We humbly beseech thy Majesty, O Lord, that the sacred mysteries we celebrate may cleanse us from all past offences, and from those we may hereafter be guilty of. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Sanctificationibus tuis, omnipotens Deus, et vitia nostra curentur, et
remedia nobis aeterna proveniant. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum...

translations.text: May our vices be cured, O Almighty God! and an eternal remedy procured for us by these sacred mysteries. Thro'.

propers.incipit: Beata gens, cujus est Dominus Deus
propers.name: Second Gradual

propers.incipit: Aufer a me opprobrium et contemptum
propers.name: Communion

propers.incipit: Benedictus es, Domine Deus patrum nostrorum
propers.name: Hymn (Benedictus es)
Collect
propers.text:
Dirigat corda nostra, quaesumus, Domine, tuae miserationis operatio:
quia tibi sine te placere non possumus. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum...

translations.text: May the influence of thy mercy, O Lord, direct our souls: for without thy help we can do nothing well pleasing to thee. Thro'.

propers.name: Offertory
propers.text:
Sanctificavit Moyses altare Domino, offerens super illud holocausta et
immolans victimas: fecit sacrificium vespertinum in odorem suavitatis
Domino Deo, in conspectu filiorum Israël.

propers.incipit: Deus, qui nos, per hujus sacrificii
propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Deus, qui nos, per hujus sacrificii veneranda commercia, unius summae
divinitatis participes efficis: praesta, quaesumus; ut, sicut tuam
cognoscimus veritatem, sic eam dignis moribus assequamur. Per Dominum
nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: O God, who by the participation of this august sacrifice makest us partakers of the one supreme divine nature: grant, we beseech thee, that as we know thy truth, so we may shew it by a worthy conduct of life. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Gratias tibi referimus, Domine, sacro munere vegetati: tuam
misericordiam deprecantes; ut dignos nos ejus participatione
perficias. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Being fed, O Lord, with tois Loly sacrifice: we give thee thanks, humbly beseeching thy mercy: that thou wouldst make us worthy of what we have received. Thro'.

propers.name: Introit
propers.text:
Salus populi ego sum, dicit Dominus: de quacumque tribulatione
clamaverint ad me, exaudiam eos: et ero illorum Dominus in perpetuum.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Omnipotens et misericors Deus, universa nobis adversantia propitiatus
exclude: ut mente et corpore pariter expediti, quae tua sunt, liberis
mentibus exsequamur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: O Almighty and mertiful God, favourably defend us from all adversity: that being free both in soul and body, we may with security of mind perform thy service. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Haec munera, quaesumus, Domine, quae oculis tuae majestatis offerimus,
salutaria nobis esse concede. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Grant, we beseech thee, O Lord, that the offerings we bring before thy divine Majesty may avail to our salvation, Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Tua nos, Domine, medicinalis operatio, et a nostris perversitatibus
clementer expediat, et tuis semper faciat inhaerere mandatis. Per
Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: May the healing efficacy of these thy mysteries O Lord, mercifully free us from our perverseness, and make us always obedient to thy commandments. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Largire, quaesumus, Domine, fidelibus tuis indulgentiam placatus et
pacem: ut pariter ab omnibus mundentur offensis, et secura tibi mente
deserviant. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Favourably grant, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy servants both pardon and peace; that, being cleansed from the guilt of all committed offences, they may serve thee with secure minds Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Coelestem nobis praebeant haec mysteria, quaesumus, Domine, medicinam:
et vitia nostri cordis expurgent. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum...

translations.text: May these mysteries, O Lord, we beseech thee, procure us a heavenly remedy, and cleanse away the vices of our hearts. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Ut sacris, Domine, reddamur digni muneribus: fac nos, quaesumus, tuis
semper oboedire mandatis. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: That we may be worthy of thy sacred gifts, O Lord: grant, we beseech thee, we may always obey thy commandments. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Familiam tuam, quaesumus, Domine, continua pietate custodi: ut a
cunctis adversitatibus, te protegente, sit libera, et in bonis actibus
tuo nomini sit devota. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Preserve thy family, O Lord, we beseech thee, by thy constant mercy: that under thy protection, it may be freed from all adversity; and by the practice of good works, continue devoted to thy name. Thro'.

propers.name: Offertory
propers.text:
Vir erat in terra Hus, nomine Job: simplex et rectus ac timens Deum:
quem Satan petiit ut tentaret: et data est ei potestas a Domino in
facultates et in carnem ejus: perdiditque omnem substantiam ipsius et
filios: carnem quoque ejus gravi ulcere vulneravit.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Suscipe, Domine, propitius hostias: quibus et te placari voluisti, et
nobis salutem potenti pietate restitui. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum...

translations.text: Mercifully receive, O Lord, these offerings, by which thou art pleased to be appeased, and restore us to salvation by thy powerful goodness, Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Immortalitatis alimoniam consecuti, quaesumus, Domine: ut, quod ore
percepimus, pura mente sectemur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum...

translations.text: Having received the food of immortality, we beseech thee, O Lord, that what we have taken with our mouths we may receive with pure souls. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, refugium nostrum et virtus: adesto piis Ecclesiae tuae precibus,
auctor ipse pietatis, et praesta; ut, quod fideliter petimus,
efficaciter consequamur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: O God, our refuge and strength, fountain of all goodness, mercifully give ear to the fervent prayers of thy church, and grant, that what we ask with faith, we may effectually obtain. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Da, misericors Deus: ut haec salutaris oblatio et a propriis nos
reatibus indesinenter expediat, et ab omnibus tueatur adversis. Per
Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Grant, O merciful God, that this sacrifice of salvation may constantly both free us from our sins, and protect us from all adversity. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Sumpsimus, Domine, sacri dona mysterii, humiliter deprecantes: ut,
quae in tui commemorationem nos facere praecepisti, in nostrae
proficiant infirmitatis auxilium: Qui vivis...

translations.text: Having received, O Lord, the sacred mysteries, we humbly beseech thee, that what thou hast ordered us to do in remembrance of thee, may be a help to our weakness. Thro'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Absolve, quaesumus, Domine, tuorum delicta populorum: ut a peccatorum
nexibus, quae pro nostra fragilitate contraximus, tua benignitate
liberemur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Pardon, O Lord, we beseech thee, the sins of thy people: that we may be delivered by thy goodness from the guilt we have contracted by our own weakness, Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Pro nostrae servitutis augmento sacrificium tibi, Domine, laudis
offerimus: ut, quod immeritis contulisti, propitius exsequaris. Per
Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: We offer thee, O Lord, this sacrifice of praise, as a repeated token of our homage; that thou mayest accomplish in us what thou hast already granted beyond our deserts. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut, quos divina tribuis participatione
gaudere, humanis non sinas subjacere periculis. Per Dominum nostrum
Jesum Christum...

translations.text: We beseech thee, O Almighty God, that thou wouldst not leave exposed to the dangers of this life, those whom thou hast joyfully made partakers of this divine food. Thro'.

masses.name: Third Sunday after the Epiphany, resumed after Pentecost

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, infirmitatem nostram propitius respice:
atque, ad protegendum nos, dexteram tuae majestatis extende. Per
Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: O almighty and eterna] God, mercifully regard our weakness, and stretch forth the right hand of thy majesty to protect us. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Haec hostia, Domine, quaesumus, emundet nostra delicta: et, ad
sacrificium celebrandum, subditorum tibi corpora mentesque
sanctificet. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: May this offering, O Lord, we beseech thee, cleanse away our sins: and sanctify the bodies and souls of thy servants, to prepare them for worthily celebrating this sacrifice. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Quos tantis, Domine, largiris uti mysteriis: quaesumus; ut effectibus
nos eorum veraciter aptare digneris. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum...

translations.text: We beseech thee, O Lord, that we, to whom thou vouchsafest the use of these great mysteries, may be made truly worthy to receive the benefits thereof. Thro'.

masses.name: Fourth Sunday after the Epiphany, resumed after Pentecost

propers.incipit: Deus, qui nos, in tantis periculis
propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui nos, in tantis periculis constitutos, pro humana scis
fragilitate non posse subsistere: da nobis salutem mentis et corporis;
ut ea, quae pro peccatis nostris patimur, te adjuvante vincamus. Per
Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: O God, who knowest that thro’ human frailty we are not able to subsist amidst so many dangers, grant us health of soul and body; that whatsoever we suffer for our sins, we may overcome by thy assistance. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Concede, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut hujus sacrificii munus oblatum
fragilitatem nostram ab omni malo purget semper et muniat. Per Dominum
nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that the offering of this sacrifice may always cleanse our frailty from all evil, and be a protection to us. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Munera tua nos, Deus, a delectationibus terrenis expediant: et
coelestibus semper instaurent alimentis. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum...

translations.text: May thy gifts, which we have partaken of, O God, detach us from all earthly pleasures, and ever refresh and strengthen us with heavenly food. Thro'.

masses.name: Fifth Sunday after the Epiphany, resumed after Pentecost

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Familiam tuam, quaesumus, Domine, continua pietate custodi: ut, quae
in sola spe gratiae coelestis innititur, tua semper protectione
muniatur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Preserve, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy family by thy constant mercy, that we, who confide solely in the support of thy heavenly grace, may be always defended by thy protection. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Hostias tibi, Domine, placationis offerimus: ut et delicta nostra
miseratus absolvas, et nutantia corda tu dirigas. Per Dominum nostrum
Jesum Christum...

translations.text: We offer thee, O Lord, this sacrifice of propitiation: that thou wouldst mercifully forgive us our sins, and guide our tottering hearts. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut illius salutaris capiamus effectum,
cujus per haec mysteria pignus accepimus. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum...

translations.text: We, beseech thee, O Almighty God, that we may one day receive the effects of that salvation, of which we have received the pledge in these mysteries. Thro'.

masses.name: Sixth Sunday after the Epiphany, resumed after Pentecost

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Praesta, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut, semper rationabilia
meditantes, quae tibi sunt placita, et dictis exsequamur et factis.
Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that being always intent upon what is reasonable and just, we may, both in word and deed, perform what is acceptable to thee. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Haec nos oblatio, Deus, mundet, quaesumus, et renovet, gubernet et
protegat. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: May this oblation, O God, we beseech thee, cleanse, renew, govern and protect us.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Coelestibus, Domine, pasti deliciis: quaesumus; ut semper eadem, per
quae veraciter vivimus, appetamus. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum
Christum...

masses.name: Twenty-fourth and Last Sunday after Pentecost

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Excita, quaesumus, Domine, tuorum fidelium voluntates: ut, divini
operis fructum propensius exsequentes; pietatis tuae remedia majora
percipiant. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Stir up, we beseech thee, O Lord, the hearts of thy faithful: that, becoming more zealous in the performance of good works, they may receive from thy goodness more effectual remedies for their disorders. Thro'.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Propitius esto, Domine, supplicationibus nostris: et, populi tui
oblationibus precibusque susceptis, omnium nostrum ad te corda
converte; ut, a terrenis cupiditatibus liberati, ad coelestia
desideria transeamus. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Mercifully receive, O Lord, the prayers and offerings of thy people: turn our hearts to thee; that being freed from earthly concupiscence, we may desire heavenly pleasures. Thro'.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Concede nobis, quaesumus, Domine: ut per haec sacramenta quae
sumpsimus, quidquid in nostra mente vitiosum est, ipsorum
medicationis dono curetur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum...

translations.text: Grant, we beseech thee, O Lord, that whatever vice our souls are subject to may be cured by the virtue of the sacrament we have received. Thro'.
